mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_user WHERE deleted = 0) AS userCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_order WHERE deleted = 0) AS orderCount, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(actual_weight), 0) FROM biz_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND order_type = 1 AND status = 13) AS recycleWeight, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(carbon_saved), 0) FROM biz_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND order_type = 1 AND status = 13) AS carbonSaved, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(change_value), 0) FROM points_record WHERE change_value > 0) AS pointsIssued, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product WHERE deleted = 0) AS productCount

SELECT DATE(create_time) AS statDate, COUNT(*) AS orderCount, IFNULL(SUM(actual_weight), 0) AS totalWeight FROM biz_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND order_type = 1 AND status = 13 AND create_time >= #{startDate} GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY statDate
SELECT status AS status, order_type AS orderType, COUNT(*) AS total FROM biz_order WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY status, order_type ORDER BY total DESC

SELECT DATE(create_time) AS statDate, SUM(CASE WHEN change_value > 0 THEN change_value ELSE 0 END) AS earn, SUM(CASE WHEN change_value < 0 THEN -change_value ELSE 0 END) AS spend FROM points_record WHERE create_time >= #{startDate} GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY statDate

SELECT oi.item_name AS productName, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS orderCount, IFNULL(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) AS totalQuantity FROM order_item oi INNER JOIN biz_order o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.deleted = 0 AND o.status NOT IN (30, 50) AND oi.item_type = 1 GROUP BY oi.item_name ORDER BY totalQuantity DESC LIMIT #{limit}
